e9::adocao-anonima.text03: A Brazilian receivables investment fund (FIDC) originator has a healthcare receivables financing operation installed in its own organizational context, with products, policy, workflows, and a credit desk.
e9::adocao-anonima.notes: Presentation paths: 20 · 40 · 60. Present adoption within this precise scope, using the anonymous description. The demonstrable journey appears on the proposal, execution and documentation, credit desk, and disbursement slides, always with the demonstration caption. The diagram shows the four elements of the installation: products, policy, workflows, and credit desk.
e9::tecnica-abertura.notes: Presentation paths: 40 · 60. Guide the discussion through a receivables case: channel API, orchestration, policy, calculations, signing, credit desk, and audit trail. The integration slide expands on the receivables API; the composition slide expands on the building blocks. The diagram represents the responsibilities of existing capabilities. Return to the white-label proposition and the choice of on-premises or SaaS on the brand and hosting slides.
acn::acn-arquitetura.notes: One Financial's institutional case study describes applications across multiple clouds and the observability adopted by operations: https://www.dynatrace.com/partners/stories/accenture-one-financial/. Architectural fit is a design proposal: identify the journey's data, events, interfaces, authentication, owners, and records. The receivables API appears on the integration slide; workflows and independent building blocks complete the map. Integration with the selected operation is the focus of the joint work.
acn::acn-contexto.text03: Vivere brings a history in mortgage-processing technology. One Financial spans lending, collections, document processing, and payments. The proposal is to add Catalisa's composition capabilities alongside that operational experience.
acn::acn-contexto.notes: Institutional context. Accenture's September 26, 2013 earnings call transcript, passage on its stake in Vivere Brasil and Vivere's work in mortgage-processing technology: https://www.investor.accenture.com/~/media/Files/A/Accenture-IR-V3/quarterly-earnings/2013/q4fy13/ACN-Transcript-2013-09-26t20-30.pdf. One Financial's stated portfolio appears in the institutional case study published by Dynatrace: https://www.dynatrace.com/partners/stories/accenture-one-financial/. The sources describe existing operations; the final sentence presents the partnership proposal.
acn::acn-esteira.text03: From document receipt to assessment and authorization, every handoff needs context. For the selected journey, we propose combining workflows, the case file, and the credit desk with document verification led by One Financial.
acn::acn-esteira.notes: Document processing is part of One Financial's portfolio. Catalisa organizes dependencies and response waits in workflows and brings execution documents together in the credit desk's case file for review. The proposal scopes this combination to the selected journey. The diagram follows the document through a task, a case file, and team verification to authorization. The case file slide that follows shows this capability. Source for the operational context: https://www.dynatrace.com/partners/stories/accenture-one-financial/.
acn::acn-garantias.notes: Vivere's mortgage experience and One Financial's credit lines connect with Catalisa's verification of property registry records and documents, renewed collateral checks before each disbursement, and obligation monitoring, including loans secured by livestock. The four flagship offerings follow. Regulatory context: Lei nº 14.711 (Brazilian collateral framework law), October 30, 2023: https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2023/lei/l14711.htm. The institution determines the applicable legal treatment and verifies the required acts.
acn::acn-piloto.notes: The discussion selects one journey of interest. Receivables provide a demonstrable option for exploring terms, signing, the credit desk, and authorization; the four flagship offerings guide the choice of audience and product. Proposed acceptance criteria: verified proposal terms; accessible policy version and decision path; a signed document with a completion certificate; the credit desk step recorded in the journey; and accessible transaction history. The owners define the baseline, cost and time data collection, and the method for recording the evaluation. The following proposal and decisioning slides allow two of these criteria to be examined during the presentation.
